title: ISO 14001:2015 Readiness & Gap Assessment Checklist
subtitle: A practical checklist for assessing environmental management system readiness against ISO 14001
intro: ISO 14001 certification depends on an environmental management system that demonstrably controls significant environmental impacts. This checklist sets out a practical sequence for assessing EMS maturity and closing gaps before certification or recertification audit.

sections.title: Context & Scope
items: Define the EMS scope, including sites, activities, and processes covered
Identify interested parties and their relevant environmental expectations
Determine environmental conditions relevant to the organisation's context
Confirm the EMS scope statement is consistent with certification intent

sections.title: Leadership & Environmental Policy
items: Document an environmental policy approved and communicated by top management
Assign environmental management roles, responsibilities, and authorities
Set measurable environmental objectives aligned to significant impacts
Confirm management commitment to compliance and continual improvement

sections.title: Environmental Aspects & Legal Compliance
items: Maintain a register of environmental aspects and evaluate their significance
Identify and maintain a compliance obligations register covering applicable legislation
Evaluate compliance with legal and other requirements on a set frequency
Track permits, licences, and authorisations with renewal dates monitored

sections.title: Operational Controls
items: Establish operating criteria for activities associated with significant aspects
Control environmental impacts across the value chain where relevant
Maintain emergency preparedness and response procedures for environmental incidents
Manage waste, effluent, and emissions in line with operational controls

sections.title: Monitoring, Measurement & Performance
items: Monitor and measure environmental performance against defined indicators
Calibrate or verify monitoring equipment used for environmental data
Track energy, water, waste, and emissions data against targets
Evaluate environmental performance trends ahead of management review

sections.title: Internal Audit
items: Maintain an internal audit programme covering all EMS clauses and significant aspects
Assign auditors who are independent of the area being audited
Raise nonconformities with objective evidence and clear descriptions
Verify corrective actions close the root cause, not just the symptom

sections.title: Management Review
items: Hold management review at planned intervals with a defined agenda
Review compliance status, audit results, and environmental performance
Review the status of actions from previous management reviews
Record decisions on resourcing, changes, and improvement opportunities

sections.title: Continual Improvement & Certification Readiness
items: Investigate environmental nonconformities and determine root cause
Assign corrective actions with clear owners and realistic due dates
Reassess significant aspects after changes to operations or legislation
Conduct a pre-certification readiness review ahead of the external audit
